pins.name: Jeongbang Falls (정방폭포)
pins.desc: A waterfall that drops straight into the sea, one of Jeju's best-known sights. The ticket office is a few steps away (check the entry fee on Naver). It is right on Olle route 6.

pins.name: Sojeongbang Falls (소정방폭포)
pins.desc: A smaller waterfall by the shore, a short walk east of Jeongbang Falls.

pins.name: Cheonjiyeon Falls (천지연폭포)
pins.desc: A waterfall in the middle of Seogwipo town, reached by a short walk through a green gorge from the ticket office. Not on the Olle line itself, so allow time for a detour.

pins.name: Saeyeon Bridge (새연교)
pins.desc: A pedestrian bridge from the Seogwipo harbour side over to the small island of Saeseom. Good for a harbour view.

pins.name: Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market (서귀포매일올레시장)
pins.desc: Seogwipo's covered market, with food stalls and shops. The route passes its entrance (see the entrance pin).
